added.title: Graduate Environmental Scientist: Contamination & Remediation
added.description:
Infrastructure Consulting Pty in Adelaide seeks a Graduate Environmental Scientist to join our Site Contamination Team. You will work with experienced professionals across projects in infrastructure, development and construction.

This role offers hands-on project experience, mentoring, and opportunities to develop technical skills while starting your career in a supportive environment, with exposure to site investigations, risk assessment and regulatory compliance.
